newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major leaves palace after meeting Queen.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major leaves palace after meeting Queen.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major left Buckingham Palace at around 1208 GMT to return to his Downing Street residence after an audience with head of state Queen Elizabeth.
The Conservative prime minister was believed to have asked the monarch to dissolve parliament, clearing the way for an election on May 1.
Officials said Major would speak to journalists outside his residence at around 1230 GMT.
